expected_outcomes: Versioned behavior maps to reviewed commits and reproducible artifacts.
required_actions: Use semantic versions, tag reviewed commits, update changelog and migration notes, and record known limitations.
expected_documents: Changelog, migration note, tag, and artifact provenance.
acceptance: Unreleased capabilities are not described as shipped.
verification: Trace version, tag, commit, artifact, and documented limitations.
evidence: Tag, commit SHA, artifact digest, and release notes.
failure_conditions: A tag points to an unreviewed commit or a release claim lacks an artifact.
exceptions: Mark prerelease and non-shipping states explicitly.
